items.title: Property (V) implies the comparison of cohomology in degrees up to n
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the cohomological counterpart of the comparison of higher direct images: under the comparison situation and hypothesis (V_n), the cohomology on the coarser site of the pullback of an object of A_X agrees with that of the object itself in degrees at most n (statement lines 7028-7035). The proof is a complete spectral sequence argument: the unbounded Leray result identifies one side with the cohomology of a derived pushforward (proof lines 7037-7039), the spectral sequence is displayed, hypothesis (V_n) kills all terms with positive p in the relevant range so that only the terms with p = 0 survive (proof lines 7039-7055), and the comparison follows (proof lines 7055-7057). The non-formal content is the vanishing bookkeeping on the second page. The claim is H2: a displayed spectral sequence with the vanishing input used explicitly.
